title: The He Clan Bows
summary: In the valley, Xiao Yan refines Mighty Huang Pills and causes a small explosion by being greedy with his last ingredients, while Zi Yan sleeps in a cocoon. Medusa tells him the step from Dou Wang to Dou Huang can take half a year or more. Taking the pills to Qingshan Town, Xiao Yan finds that He Qian, head of the He Clan, has seized Ka Gang over the Fire Lotus Vial. Xiao Yan slaps He Qian down with Dou Huang force, and He Qian recognises him as leader of the Yan Alliance and begs for mercy. Xiao Yan accepts the He Clan into the alliance but warns them off the Bloody Battle Mercenary Company. Back in the valley he enters seclusion, and Medusa seals the valley before her clan summons her away. Xiao Yan breaks through to Dou Huang and glimpses Yao Lao in the Hall of Souls.
